integrity: The exact Smith invariant factors are computed from explicit integer differentials using unimodular operations; the bundled Python 3 certificate reproduces Jacobi, d-square-zero, ranks, torsion and a nonboundary cocycle. Historical priority remains provisional.
scientific_limitations: Ordinary adjoint Lie cohomology for a single specified six-generator integral Lie ring and all field base changes; does not classify all restricted or formal deformations. The nonzero family is proved only to be nonisomorphic to the undeformed member. Independent audit not performed.
title: Integral adjoint cohomology and characteristic-two deformation of a six-dimensional toral \(\mathfrak{sl}_2\) extension
